name: BHIS (brain-heart-infusion supplemented) media (PMC13185528)
description: BHIS (brain-heart-infusion supplemented) media, a rich medium extracted from Spiga et al. (2026). Mapped to BiGG from the paper's stated composition.

provenance.citation: Spiga et al. An anaerobic pathogen rewires host metabolism to fuel oxidative growth in the inflamed gut. Cell (2026). DOI: 10.1016/j.cell.2026.04.012. [PMC13185528]
provenance.notes: Extracted from the primary paper (snippet: brain-heart-infusion supplemented (BHIS) media (0.8% brain heart infusion from solid, 0.5% peptic digest of animal tissue, 1.6% pancreatic digest of casein, 0.5% sodium chloride, 0.2% glucose, 0.25% d). Component names mapped to BiGG (see mapping_confidence); presence-based bounds unless the paper gave exchange bounds; concentration_mM where units allowed. Extraction confidence: high.
provenance.base_expansion: Base 'BHI' expanded to standard composition: Brain Heart Infusion (BD): brain/heart infusion solids, peptone, NaCl, phosphate, dextrose (in-silico approximation).
provenance.verification_evidence: brain-heart-infusion supplemented (BHIS) media (0.8% brain heart infusion from solid, 0.5% peptic digest of animal tissue, 1.6% pancreatic digest of casein, 0.5% sodium chloride, 0.2% glucose, 0.25% disodium hydrogen phosphate, 0.005% haemin, 0.0001% vitamin K, pH 7.4)

Peptic digest of animal tissue (proteose.citation: Proteose peptone = enzymatic protein digest. Source: BD Bionutrient Technical Manual.

Pancreatic digest of casein (tryptone).citation: Tryptone = pancreatic (tryptic) digest of casein; amino-acid-rich, tryptophan retained. Source: BD Bionutrient Technical Manual; casein amino-acid profile (FAO/WHO).

coverage_source.definition: pct_covered_all divides components by (components + unresolved ingredients). It counts pipeline-derived components as covered, so it is not a measure of how much of the source's own ingredient list was captured. pct_covered_source divides source-stated components by (those + unresolved ingredients + ingredients replaced by derived components), which is that measure. Component classes come from tools/component_evidence_classes.tsv. A null value means the denominator was zero; it does not mean 100.
